$comment: P69 (lane `cs`, D-C-A-NON-VOID-FUNCTION-WHOSE-END-IS-REACHABLE-IS-REFUSED, the other direction): value-returning functions whose last statement is not a `return` and whose end NO execution reaches. Since P69 a reached end is accepted with a warning (C23 6.9.2p13), so an end DSS merely FAILS TO SEE as unreached is a warning no reference gives — and before P69 it was a refusal of valid C. Each function here is complete only because the CST->HIR lowering sees it: a constant `if` whose live arm leaves, a `do` whose body never reaches its condition, an expression statement that cannot finish (a direct call of a function that does not return, through a conditional's BOTH arms, a comma, a cast), a condition that is a constant only through the target's layout (`sizeof`, `_Alignof`, `offsetof`, the `&((T *)0)->m` spelling) or through a selection the compiler made when it typed the expression (`_Generic`), and a loop on such a condition. `forbidDiagnostics` holds exactly that: the compile must not report H_NonVoidFunctionEndReachable for any of them. ★ AND THE SAME SIGHT IS A CLAIM THE BACK END MAY ACT ON, so the file's second half is what must NOT be claimed, each RUN: a `case` / `default` label of the enclosing switch inside the arm a constant `if` never takes (the switch jumps in, and the statement after the `if` runs); a statement whose only way out is a `goto` to a later label (the label's code runs); a conditional callee, a pointer callee and a conditional with one live arm (control goes on when the live function is chosen); `sizeof` of a variably modified operand (a run-time value: both outcomes of each branch happen). The callees REALLY do not return — they leave through longjmp — so every never-continuing statement is executed, not merely compiled; the program exits 42 only if every function returned what it should or left with the code it should (a distinct exit code per check).
$decisionComment: ONE ANSWER HERE IS DSS'S DECISION, recorded as one: a call that PRECEDES the declaration which adds `_Noreturn` (`late_plain`, `late_both_arms`, `late_comma`, `late_cast`) is a call of a function that does not return. 'A function declared with a _Noreturn function specifier shall not return to its caller' (C23 6.7.5p8) puts no condition on where the declaration stands. gcc 13.3.0, mingw-w64 gcc and cl 14.51 agree (no report on such a body); clang 18.1.3 reports it at -O0 and -O2 — the measurement and its run ids are in the row.
